Hi Ian — thanks again for the 30-minute demo earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side:  

1) Summary of ask: Novaline is evaluating a production LLM inference stack for customer-facing summarization and search with hard latency and cost targets. You mentioned a Q3 procurement window and an initial pilot budget scoped to the analytics team.  

2) Open questions we need clarified to map approvals:  
- Who is the economics/budget owner who signs off on the pilot (title/name/email)?
- Who owns security and procurement at Novaline for vendor onboarding (Sophie? role confirmation appreciated).
- Any required vendor documents we should prepare early (SOC 2, data retention, IP language)?

3) Proposed next steps:  
- Intro thread to the budget owner + procurement to align on pilot scope and acceptance criteria (30–45m).
- We’ll share a 1-page mutual action plan and a high-level scope doc (attached).
- Ben will follow up on compliance checklist items and a short SOC 2 summary.

Action: Can you introduce the person who controls the pilot budget and confirm whether Sophie Lin should own procurement coordination? If there’s a separate legal contact who handles standard MSA redlines, please loop them in.  

I attached the preliminary scope (novaline_scope_v1.pdf) and the mutual-action-plan.xlsx for your review. I’ll wait for the intro and then propose two times for a joint alignment call.

Thanks — Marissa
